title: 第5章 觉醒仪式第6章 觉醒龙魂
content_zh:
江若尘来到特定区域，这里除了等待觉醒的人外，一些已经觉醒了武魂的王子公主，王侯将相的子嗣，也有特权站立在这一方。
这是最好的位置，方便他们观礼。
江若尘看了他们一眼，并未选择过去，而是自己找了一个寻常的位置站立，等待仪式的开始。
可即便如此，其他的王子公主还是注意到了他。
“这个废物，九次了还不死心？都十六岁了，要能觉醒早就觉醒了，还要过来丢脸，这不是诚心给我们王室蒙羞吗！”
十一王子江立恶狠狠的瞪着江若尘。
九王子冷哼附和：“前几天更是去秦府找事，被秦琪打成了重伤，还是被人抬回王宫的！
这种废物，他为什么不去死？活着尽给父王抹黑！”
六公主极度不屑的瞥了江若尘一眼，很不在意道：“算了吧，反正这是最后一次了，按照宗人府规定，王子十六岁未觉醒武魂，都会被废为庶人，发配燕山，过了今天，我们王室的这个污点就抹除了。”
这些人议论江若尘的声音毫不顾忌，以至于周围很多人都听到了。
高台上的婉妃听到这些话，深深的愤怒与心疼，可在这样的场合，她一个妃子什么都不能做，只能在心里默默给江若尘打气。
江若尘自然也听到了，只是他并未理会。
过了今天，他将潜龙出渊，一飞冲天！
如今讥讽他的嘴脸，他都将慢慢的抽回去！
也就在这时，江若尘似乎心有所感，转头朝着最高的王室观礼台方向看去。
就见最高的王座旁，坐着一个身着极奢华服，头戴凤冠，看起来三十岁左右的贵妇人正冰冷的盯着他。
头戴凤冠，又能坐在王座旁的人，除了镇南王妃，还能是谁？
再看看她身旁捂着脸泪眼婆娑的小翠，江若尘立马明白她为何会如此盯着自己了。
王妃的刻薄，在整个王宫是人尽皆知的事情，自己今日打了小翠，她知晓了怎么可能不记恨？
不过江若尘并不在意，只要他不给王妃抓住把柄！

凭自己王子的身份，王妃也不能肆意妄为。
“大王近日闭关，今年武魂觉醒仪式由本后代为主持。”
在江若尘的注视下，王后忽然起身，而后对着所有人宣布：“武魂觉醒仪式，开始。”
呜……
王后一声令下，武魂觉醒仪式正式开始，呜呜号角声响彻王城，刽子手挥起屠刀，斩杀妖兽，牲畜。
用鲜血来开启武魂觉醒的第一步，祭祀天坛。
这武魂天坛是一座呈四方形的巨大祭坛，而在天坛的中央，悬挂着一座古老的青铜古钟，其上篆刻着奇珍异兽，天地山川，以及日月星辰。
那便是帮助普通人觉醒武魂的媒介，所有的修炼者，都要通过青铜钟，觉醒自己的武魂。
随着刽子手的屠刀接连落下，无数道血光喷射而出，全都注入了武魂天坛中央的古老青铜钟。
嗡……
跟往年一样，血光注入青铜钟后，整个祭坛开始激活，不仅散发出阵阵威压，更神奇的是，青铜钟篆刻的图案也似乎活了过来。
化作一个个血光图案，漂浮满了整个天坛。
就在这时，一个约莫七八岁的小女孩，似乎受到了天坛的吸引，失神了一般不顾周围情况的朝着天坛走去。
看到这一幕，所有人都露出了惊讶的神情。
“那不是王侍郎家的女儿吗？她才六岁啊，就要成今天第一个觉醒武魂的人？”
content_en:
Jiang Ruochen came to a specific area. In addition to those waiting for awakening, some princes and princesses who had awakened their martial spirits, and the heirs of princes, generals, and ministers also had the privilege to stand here.
This is the best location for them to watch the ceremony.
Jiang Ruochen glanced at them and did not choose to go over. Instead, he found an ordinary place to stand and waited for the ceremony to begin.
But even so, other princes and princesses still noticed him.
"This loser, you haven't given up even after nine times? He's already sixteen years old. He would have woken up a long time ago if he could, and he still wants to come here to embarrass himself. Isn't this sincerity to bring shame to our royal family!"
The eleventh prince Jiang Li glared at Jiang Ruochen fiercely.
The Ninth Prince snorted and agreed: "A few days ago, I even went to the Qin Mansion to look for trouble. I was severely injured by Qin Qi, but I was carried back to the palace!
This kind of trash, why doesn't he die? Live to discredit your father! "
The sixth princess glanced at Jiang Ruochen with extreme disdain and said nonchalantly: "Forget it, this is the last time anyway. According to the regulations of the clan, any prince who has not awakened his martial spirit at the age of sixteen will be deposed as a commoner and be sent to Yanshan. After today, this stain on our royal family will be erased."
These people talked about Jiang Ruochen without any scruples, so much so that many people around them heard it.
When Concubine Wan on the high platform heard these words, she was deeply angry and distressed. But in such an occasion, she, a concubine, could do nothing but cheer Jiang Ruochen silently in her heart.
Jiang Ruochen naturally heard it, but he ignored it.
After today, he will emerge from the abyss and soar into the sky!
Now that you are mocking him, he will slowly withdraw it!
At this moment, Jiang Ruochen seemed to feel something in his heart and turned to look in the direction of the highest royal viewing platform.
He saw a lady in her thirties, wearing extremely luxurious clothes and a phoenix crown, sitting next to the highest throne, staring at him coldly.
Besides Princess Zhennan, who else could wear a phoenix crown and sit next to the throne?
Looking at Xiao Cui next to her, covering her face with tears in her eyes, Jiang Ruochen immediately understood why she was staring at him like this.
The princess's meanness is well known in the entire palace. She beat Xiaocui today. How could she not hold grudges if she knew about it?
But Jiang Ruochen didn't care, as long as he didn't give the princess any leverage!
As a prince, the princess cannot act arbitrarily.
"Your Majesty has been in retreat recently. This year's martial soul awakening ceremony will be hosted by this descendant."
Under Jiang Ruochen's gaze, the queen suddenly stood up and announced to everyone: "The martial soul awakening ceremony begins."
Woo...
With the queen's order, the martial soul awakening ceremony officially began. The sound of horns resounded throughout the royal city, and the executioner waved his butcher knife to kill monsters and livestock.
Use blood to start the first step of awakening the martial soul and sacrifice to the Temple of Heaven.
The Wuhun Temple of Heaven is a huge square-shaped altar, and in the center of the Temple of Heaven hangs an ancient bronze bell, with seals engraved on it are engraved with rare and exotic animals, heaven, earth, mountains and rivers, as well as the sun, moon and stars.
That is the medium that helps ordinary people awaken their martial souls. All cultivators must awaken their martial souls through the bronze bell.
As the executioner's butcher's knife fell one after another, countless rays of blood spurted out, all injected into the ancient bronze bell in the center of the Wuhun Temple of Heaven.
Buzz…
As in previous years, after the blood light was injected into the bronze bell, the entire altar began to activate. Not only did it exude waves of pressure, but what was even more magical was that the pattern carved on the bronze bell seemed to come alive.
It turned into bloody patterns, floating all over the Temple of Heaven.
At this moment, a little girl about seven or eight years old seemed to be attracted by the Temple of Heaven, and walked toward the Temple of Heaven in a daze, regardless of the surrounding situation.
Seeing this scene, everyone looked surprised.
"Isn't that the daughter of Wang Shilang's family? She is only six years old, and she will be the first person to awaken the martial spirit today?"
